scope: Quatro adultos originais; dois bípedes e dois quadrúpedes. Nomes e lore propostos.

members.name: Lupunhal
members.story: Abre uma passagem curta cortando a linha da arma adversária; precisa entrar no alcance do oponente.
members.design: BIPED upright digitigrade gray-wolf duelist, compact athletic torso broad shoulders but narrow hips, TWO complete arms and TWO complete wolf legs, medium wolf muzzle not human or cub. Sharp mint-green eyes, asymmetrical pale silver folded cheek collar, graphite taut-paper body, cobalt and muted teal armor with ivory accents. TWO broad short dagger blades shaped like stretched split bamboo quills, one held low in the near hand, one reversed in the far hand visibly apart from torso. Big layered shoulder collar, flexible framed chest cuirass, bracers and angular greaves; no huge cape. A doubled bamboo bow shape behind both ears acts as a split guard, not antlers. Tense low poised fighting stance, far arm fully visible. ONE long braided teal soul-rabiola rooted rear pelvis ending in three compact gray folded wolftrack flags. Expressive veteran alert face, controlled dangerous calm; silhouette a compact diagonal X.

members.name: Dirubastião
members.story: Ancora as quatro patas para lançar uma grande seta almática; perde mobilidade enquanto tensiona a balista.
members.design: QUADRUPED heavy ancient wolf siege guardian, FOUR distinct robust legs and FOUR visible planted paws, broad deep chest and massive short jaw, small mature violet eyes, no saber fangs. Wide armored mane and arched back, mature dignified growling face. Charcoal/burgundy living-paper body, ochre-gold reinforced armor, ivory jaw and folded underneck. Tall massive front shoulder bulwarks, layered chest armor centered under throat, leg greaves supported by bamboo braces, broad quiet paper flank. A SINGLE compact giant dorsal CROSSBOW ballista lies lengthwise on the spine, rear joint anchored above pelvis and front fork ABOVE shoulders, two thick lateral bamboo limbs forming one crescent; taut line and ONE long luminous violet spectral bolt aligned FORWARD, not through head. Mechanical assembly separate from animal joints, not real gun. No arms, no wings, no wheel legs. ONE heavy braided ochre soul-rabiola rooted behind hindquarters with burgundy siege-banner terminal distinct from bowstring. Full grounded braced three-quarter stance, armor volume and authority.

members.name: Etruslança
members.story: Guia a investida pelo giro de uma lança com vela lateral; a área ampla de manobra limita o uso em corredores.
members.design: BIPED tall ancient wolf standard-lancer, TWO arms and TWO wolf digitigrade legs, long narrow triangular wolf muzzle, upright ears, serious deep crimson eyes, no human face. Upright noble torso and broad powerful thighs, not skinny generic knight. Verdigris GREEN living-paper membranes, warm ivory collar and abdomen, plum-violet armor with antique copper borders. Distinct asymmetric high crescent neckguard leaves wolf muzzle free, heavy rounded shoulder armor with downward hooked rear edges, broad curved chest lamellae and articulated skirt THREE large broad kite-sail panels, no tiny triangles. TWO-handed long fantasy glaive held diagonally outward with both separated hands clearly gripping the same continuous bamboo shaft; one large hooked ivory blade and a short taut jade side-sail near blade turn the weapon into a wind rudder. No other weapon, no extra arms or floating spear. ONE rooted braided plum soul-rabiola and forked green banner terminal. Adult leading-a-turn pose, clear face and supports; tall vertical banner silhouette.

members.name: Miralís
members.story: Marca um alvo distante estabilizando a arma no próprio dorso; deve manter a posição para preservar a precisão.
members.design: QUADRUPED long slender Ethiopian-wolf inspired precision ranger, FOUR complete long graceful legs FOUR visible feet, very long narrow red-and-ivory wolf muzzle, very tall ears, focused icy BLUE eyes small mature pupils. Rust RED taut living-paper body, ivory neck/cheeks/innerlegs, black tail-tip coloration, deep petrol/navy matte light armor with copper edges. Asymmetrical large folded shoulder mantle with few dark sage sail panels on far side, light upper-leg and wrist protection, thin waist and deep narrow chest (NOT dire wolf stocky body). ONE long elegant fantasy SNIPER RIFLE of bamboo/ceramic mounted on shoulder-to-midback cradle, unbroken long ivory barrel pointing FORWARD parallel to muzzle but CLEARLY ABOVE and to far side of head, body housing an exposed large copper thread SPOOL instead of magazine; one small stylized optic, taut teal almatic line glowing inside barrel, no ammunition bullets or real-world brand. Cradle rests on two armored dorsal anchors not through neck. One floating small teal targeting ring at muzzle of barrel only. ONE braided dark red soul-rabiola rooted hindquarters with long forked ivory pennant, distinct from gun line. Alert standing stalker pose with all feet separated, head lowered to aim, agile adult anatomical coherence, not human hands or wolf holding rifle in mouth.
